text: Test 3 This is the IELTS listening test. You will hear a number of different recordings and you will have to answer questions on what you hear. There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions and you will have a chance to check your work. All the recordings will be played once only. The test is in four parts. At the end of the test you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to the answer sheet. Now turn to part one. Part one. You will hear a man called Jack giving advice to a friend about surfing holidays. First you have some time to look at questions one to six. Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six. Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10. Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.
Well, thanks very much for that. That is the end of part one. You now have half a minute to check your answers to part one. Thank you.
